## Who is a good customer for us

A distributor or maker with one to five warehouses and 20 to 200 staff, still running stock on spreadsheets or on a system they have outgrown. The operations head is the buyer; the finance head signs. A good sign: they lost an order to a stock count that was wrong. A poor fit: a single shop with no warehouse, or a company that wants software written for it alone.
